name: Agent Skills
description: Fetches and copies skills for configurable agents through the skills npm CLI.

sources.description: Comma- or newline-separated skills CLI sources, such as owner/repo or owner/repo@skill-name. Empty installs no skills.

agents.description: Comma- or whitespace-separated skills CLI agent IDs; use * for all supported agents.

version.description: npm version or tag for the skills CLI.
